messages:
jun: ok extremely important consumer research: does anyone elses toaster do a dramatic slow-spin before ejecting? i need to know if its haunted or performance art :raising_hand:

giphy-bot: *GIPHY*  posted a 2s loop (toaster-ballet.gif) https://giphy.com/gifs/toaster-ballet

maya: that gif is a mood :joy::sparkles:

ron: its not haunted. its trying to align with orbital bread standards :satellite:

jun: Ron, is there a spec? asking for a friend (and my breakfast) :grimacing:

facilities-bot: FYI facilities heard the earlier toaster rumble report. were running diagnostics at 1pm during lunch. no guarantees about liftoff :wrench:

maya: poll: dramatic spin = theatrical, keep it. or remove for safety? react with :theater_masks: to keep, :no_entry: to remove

ron: :theater_masks:

maya: :theater_masks:

jun: :no_entry: (im terrified but also entertained)

giphy-bot: :thumbsup: (reaction)

facilities-bot: ceremony scheduling note: if liftoff occurs, please clean up crumbs before leaving the kitchen. crumbs attract tributes and vibes. :broom:

jun: streaming the diagnostic. bringing bagpipes for ambience :bagpipes: :laughing:

ron: will live-caption with toast puns only. unlimited bread puns allowed :bread:

maya: please no one feed it jam during the test  it might develop taste preferences :sweat_smile:

jun: documented. jam embargo in place. see you at 1pm. (mostly reactions and a single gif)
